description: CLEARWATER, Fla. — State Rep. Berny Jacques accused the City of Largo on Tuesday of violating Florida electioneering laws by hosting a municipal town hall featuring a single guest panelist opposed to a proposed constitutional amendment that expands property tax exemptions.
title: Rep. Jacques accuses Largo of unlawful electioneering over property tax town hall » Berny Jacques for State Representative | Berny Jacques for State Representative
